source: Architecture Governance Phase 4.6 - Asset Identity Policy
description: Future normalization recommendations for typed asset identity. This file does not execute migration.

wrongTypedRelationshipPatterns.pattern: Compatibility maps use calculadora-clt-ou-pj as a cluster value for CLT ou PJ articles.
wrongTypedRelationshipPatterns.recommendedNormalization: Use cluster:clt-ou-pj for cluster identity and calculator:calculadora-clt-ou-pj for calculator identity.

slugBasedRelationships.pattern: Public catalogs and legacy compatibility references use slugs and URLs as relationship hints.
slugBasedRelationships.recommendedNormalization: Add explicit typed assetId relationships in future approved migration.

futureRecommendations.recommendation: Adopt assetId as the primary registry key and retain publicSlug as an attribute.
Treat assetId as canonical identity and publicSlug as public routing metadata.
Require assetId, assetType, publicSlug, displayName, version, status and owner in future concrete asset specs.
Use typed assetId values in relationship maps, approvals, rollback plans and reports.
Separate cluster ids, calculator ids, article ids, guide ids and nucleus ids in future compatibility normalization.
Use assetId for publishing entries and publicSlug only for route/canonical planning.

restrictions: Do not change existing public slugs.
Do not execute migration in this phase.
